protocol.name: Cosmic Signature Protocol
protocol.description: The main protocol proxy contract that manages cycles, gestures, and allocation distribution

implementation.name: Implementation Contract
implementation.description: The current implementation behind the Cosmic Signature Protocol proxy contract

cst.name: Cosmic Signature CST Token
cst.description: ERC-20 token (CST) imprinted with every gesture and used to express Coordination Weight on the Cosmic Council

nft.name: Cosmic Signature NFT
nft.description: ERC-721 NFT collection imprinted as allocations to cycle recipients

randomWalk.name: RandomWalk
randomWalk.description: RandomWalk NFT collection that can be attached to ETH gestures for a one-time discount or anchored for Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection eligibility

council.name: Cosmic Council
council.description: On-chain Protocol Coordination contract for Coordination Proposals

publicGoods.name: Public Goods Vault
publicGoods.description: Receives the Public Goods Allocation from each cycle's Cycle Reserve

outreach.name: Outreach Reserve
outreach.description: Funds allocated for outreach distributions and ecosystem contributors

allocations.name: Allocations Wallet
allocations.description: Escrow contract holding allocations awaiting retrieval

cosmicAnchor.name: Cosmic Signature NFT Anchoring Wallet
cosmicAnchor.description: Anchoring contract for Cosmic Signature NFTs

funds.title: Allocation Tracks
funds.description: How the Cycle Reserve distributes across allocation tracks: Signature Allocation, Chrono-Warrior, Stellar Selection, Public Goods, Anchor Distribution, and the Compounding Cycle Reserve.

signature.label: Signature Allocation
signature.tooltip: ETH percentage retrieved by the participant who made the Final Gesture; they also receive 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT

chrono.label: Chrono-Warrior
chrono.tooltip: ETH allocation to the Chrono-Warrior, who also receives 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT

stellar.label: Stellar Selection
stellar.tooltip: Portion distributed to randomly selected participants when the cycle finalizes

anchor.label: Anchor Distribution
anchor.tooltip: ETH Anchor Distributions to Cosmic Signature NFT anchor-holders, proportional to anchored NFT count

publicGoods.label: Public Goods
publicGoods.tooltip: Forwarded to the Public Goods Beneficiary (Protocol Guild) each cycle

next.label: Next cycle
next.tooltip: Remaining funds that roll forward into the next cycle as the Compounding Cycle Reserve.

ethStep.label: ETH Gesture-Cost Step-Up
ethStep.tooltip: ETH gesture cost uses this step-up parameter. CST gesture cost follows the live CST Calibration Window.

timeIncrement.label: Time Increment
timeIncrement.tooltip: Each gesture adds this much time to the Cycle Finalization Time. The increment grows by {percent}% with each cycle.

cstPreview.label: Current Participation CST Preview
cstPreview.tooltip: Estimated Participation CST if a gesture lands now. The amount is dynamic and uses {formula}.

finalization.label: Finalization Timeout
finalization.tooltip: Time the Final Gesture participant has to finalize the cycle before the Open-Finalization Window opens to anyone

initial.label: Initial Time Increment
initial.tooltip: The initial Cycle Finalization Time added when the first gesture is made

message.label: Max Message Length
message.tooltip: Maximum character length allowed in gesture messages

v3OutbidShare.label: Outbid Participant CST Share
v3OutbidShare.tooltip: Share of each Participation CST imprint credited to the participant being outbid; the gesturer receives the remainder immediately.

v3SignatureNfts.label: Signature Allocation NFTs
v3SignatureNfts.tooltip: Number of Cosmic Signature NFTs (sequential ids) imprinted for the Signature Allocation recipient when a cycle finalizes.

v3LateWindow.label: Late-Gesture Window
v3LateWindow.tooltip: Duration before the Cycle Finalization Time during which gesture costs carry an exponentially accelerating premium (up to ~5x).

parameters.title: Calibration Window & Stellar Selection Parameters
parameters.cstDurationTooltip: Live stored duration of the CST Calibration Window. CST gestures lengthen it by about {increase}%; ETH gestures shorten it by about {decrease}%.
parameters.cstElapsedTooltip: Time already elapsed in the current CST Calibration Window
parameters.cstCeilingTooltip: Starting Gesture Cost of the CST Calibration Window currently displayed. The cost descends linearly across the live stored duration.
parameters.ethDurationTooltip: Total duration of the ETH Calibration Window where Gesture Cost descends over time
parameters.ethElapsedTooltip: Time already elapsed in the current ETH Calibration Window
parameters.publicGoodsAddressTooltip: The on-chain address currently receiving the Public Goods Allocation from the Public Goods Vault contract
parameters.viewPublicGoodsAria: View Public Goods address on block explorer

selection.ethTooltip: Number of participants randomly selected to receive ETH allocations each cycle
selection.nftTooltip: Number of participants randomly selected to receive Cosmic Signature NFTs each cycle
selection.anchorTooltip: Number of RandomWalk NFT anchor-holders randomly selected to receive Cosmic Signature NFTs each cycle

vault.title: Public Goods Vault Action
vault.tooltip: Calls the Public Goods Vault send() function to forward the vault's ETH balance to the configured Protocol Guild beneficiary.
vault.description: Forward available public-goods funds from the vault to Protocol Guild.
vault.descriptionWithBeneficiary: Forward available public-goods funds from the vault to Protocol Guild ({address}).
vault.aria: Forward Public Goods Vault balance to Protocol Guild
